notes: USAGE BIT is implied for the subject of a GROUP-USAGE BIT entry, so its subordinates pack into BYTE-LENGTH 02 (§2002:13.16.27.2 SR2; §2002:15.12.3 RV4). A subordinate group written with no GROUP-USAGE clause is accepted as an implied bit group (§2002:13.14.3 GR1): its LENGTH is 05 and its parent's BYTE-LENGTH is 01. The forbidden forms are refused in WS and in CD: USAGE on the subject (COBOL1653), a PIC X subordinate (COBOL0881) and a NATIONAL subgroup (COBOL1653).
